raw_files_note: The raw responses are the same bytes scored on 2026-08-12 under evaluator 0.1.0; they are referenced, not copied, so one run cannot come to have two raw records. Verified identical by hash against the source kit before rescoring.
rescore_reason: The 0.1.0 verdict was withdrawn. It read `moves` and `text`; the prompt handed to the model (PROMPT-ROYA.md in the sterile kit) required `state_fen` and `explanation`. The model answered in the shape it was given, in all 12 fixtures across all 3 trials. The published 18/36 measured the disagreement between our own two statements of the contract, not the model.
known_limitations: Trial start/end timestamps were not recorded; the date carries a technical 00:00Z and is not back-dated to a guess.
A 36/36 profile does not separate models: chess v0.1 is saturated and is marked as such in the protocol.
state_tracking and interactive_play each contain a single move, so neither yet measures a trajectory.
